```go
package tmpl

import (
	"fmt"
	"strconv"
	"strings"
)

// Render replaces {{ name | filter }} tags in src with values from data.
func Render(src string, data map[string]any) (string, error) {
	var b strings.Builder
	for i := 0; i < len(src); {
		if strings.HasPrefix(src[i:], "{{{{") {
			b.WriteString("{{")
			i += 4
			continue
		}
		idx := strings.Index(src[i:], "{{")
		if idx < 0 {
			b.WriteString(src[i:])
			break
		}
		b.WriteString(src[i : i+idx])
		tagEnd := strings.Index(src[i+idx:], "}}")
		if tagEnd < 0 {
			return "", fmt.Errorf("unterminated tag %q", src[i+idx:])
		}
		body := src[i+idx+2 : i+idx+tagEnd]
		val, err := evalTag(body, data)
		if err != nil {
			return "", err
		}
		b.WriteString(val)
		i = i + idx + tagEnd + 2
	}
	return b.String(), nil
}
```

The first `{{` is at index 2. So we write src[0:2]="a ", then body=src[4:]= `{{ b` — wrong! Because `{{{{` starts at index 2, meaning the first `{{` is part of a `{{{{` sequence.

```go
for i := 0; i < len(src); {
    if strings.HasPrefix(src[i:], "{{") {
        if strings.HasPrefix(src[i:], "{{{{") {
            b.WriteString("{{")
```
